title: Patriots' Kayshon Boutte might hint that Brendan Sorsby's NFL chances are fully intact

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots' Kayshon Boutte might hint that Brendan Sorsby's NFL chances are fully intact
sources.description: If an injunction is not granted, and the NCAA's ineligibility ruling is not reversed, Sorsby's most likely next step will be to file for entry into the NFL supplemental draft.
